none: PAS NLM-514490: Roman Coin: Nummus fraction of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus fraction of House of Constantine (306-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361. Obverse description: Diademed head right, inscription clipped away. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 12.8mm, Weight: 0.60gms, die axis: 6
